claims.statement: agent/dashboard/options.py maintains the selectable model registry: each ModelOption contains a provider-prefixed id, label, per-model efforts, default_effort, image support, and optional default eligibility, while SUPPORTED_MODEL_IDS is the membership set used for validation.

Model effort and image validation are model-specific: model_supports_effort and model_supports_images check the selected ModelOption rather than treating reasoning effort or vision support as global capabilities.

Deprecated model ids do not receive canonical replacements: canonical_model_pair always returns None and provider_fallback_pair excludes deprecated ids, whereas unsupported non-deprecated ids may recover to a same-provider model with Claude-family preference.

default_model_pair() is the deployment-level terminal fallback: it reads LLM_MODEL_ID and LLM_REASONING_EFFORT, requires a supported default-eligible model and compatible effort, and raises ValueError when either configured value is invalid.

For a hosted agent run, build_agent applies a profile only when the thread lacks a stored model, uses stored thread settings when present, lets a valid explicit agent_model_id/agent_effort replace both main and subagent pairs, and persists the resulting pre-gate snapshot.

resolve_agent_model_id applies a supported per-thread model id over a valid profile model over the workspace agent default; dashboard new-thread pair resolution applies workspace, then profile, then request, except a deprecated request leaves the workspace default.

Workspace role defaults route candidates through _resolve_default_pair, which returns a valid supported/default-eligible pair, otherwise a same-provider fallback, otherwise the deployment default; review chat inherits the agent default when its own pair is absent or invalid.

Workspace settings resolve hardcoded defaults, then the instance record keyed 'default' in ['team_settings'], then sparse per-workspace overrides in ['workspace_settings']; get_workspace_settings fails soft to hardcoded defaults when storage cannot be read.

Per-user profiles in ['profiles'] store model pairs and user preferences separately from encrypted GitHub OAuth records in ['oauth_tokens'], preventing profile writes and OAuth refreshes from clobbering each other.
Run-start profile lookup is fail-soft: agent_overrides.load_profile logs failures and returns None, while dashboard callers use profiles.get_profile and receive store failures.

Profile main and subagent overrides are accepted only for supported, default-eligible models with compatible efforts; a stale non-deprecated id can recover through provider_fallback_pair, while absent or unknown-provider choices return no override.

provider_model_kwargs translates resolved efforts by provider: OpenAI reasoning, Anthropic adaptive summarized thinking plus effort, Gemini 3 thinking_level, Fireworks model_kwargs.reasoning_effort, and Baseten reasoning_effort only for low/high/max.

make_model constructs chat models with init_chat_model, defaulting shipped provider prefixes to six retries and a 600-second request timeout; it caches by model id, gateway argument, max tokens, frozen kwargs, and event-loop id, and close_cached_models closes and clears cached models.

make_model configures OpenAI for the Responses API with store=false, output_version responses/v1, and encrypted reasoning content; without gateway routing or OPENAI_API_KEY it can use desktop OpenAI OAuth.
make_model routes Baseten as an OpenAI-compatible provider and, without gateway routing, requires BASETEN_API_KEY and uses the Baseten base URL.

Gateway routing is tri-state: an effective workspace True/False is authoritative and None inherits gateway_env_default; gateway_overrides supplies direct-call replacements only for routable providers with a LangSmith key, otherwise logs and leaves the provider direct.

Runtime model fallback honors LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL_ID before its built-in mapping of Anthropic primaries to OpenAI and OpenAI primaries to Anthropic; ModelFallbackMiddleware alternates primary and fallback on retryable errors, while other provider families are not silently cross-routed.

Fable is gated workspace-wide: disabled settings rewrite saved Fable defaults, the options endpoint excludes Fable choices, and build_agent gates main, subagent, and title models after snapshot resolution so disabled Fable is not constructed.

Repository custom instructions are records in ['agent_instructions'] keyed by owner/name; a new thread resolves them for its effective default repository, snapshots them in agent_settings, and construct_system_prompt renders them as repository instructions.

Per-user custom instructions use their own ['user_instructions'] namespace keyed by GitHub login and capped at 20,000 characters so dashboard and agent tool writers do not compete with profile writes.
Personal instructions are loaded fail-soft for each participant and rendered as standing_instructions in dynamic person context rather than stored in the thread-wide system prompt.

Dashboard image-bearing creation substitutes default_vision_model_pair when the resolved model is text-only, while direct user-message construction rejects images for a missing or text-only model with HTTP 422.

Thread settings are a five-minute-cached typed agent_settings metadata snapshot containing model, subagent, routing, and repository-instruction fields; invalid snapshots normalize to empty and failed loads or writes do not abort a run.
